title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: The most American thing about American food is that “American food” is not a particularly useful category.

Yes, eat burgers, barbecue, pizza and diner breakfasts. But the country's real advantage is immigrant abundance. In major cities you can move from Mexican to Korean to Ethiopian to Indian to Vietnamese food without treating any of it as exotic expedition dining.
New York is the easiest place to exploit this. On road-trip days, however, accept that chain restaurants and giant portions are part of the cultural immersion.
